Understanding the underlying theory and translating the multi-physics equations into a correct numerical solver, then extracting birefringence values, is non-trivial and demands domain knowledge in crystallography and numerical analysis.

The evidence log adds a minor step. No complex orchestration or multi-stage dependencies. The main challenge is the implementation logic, not the workflow.
